title: Cooking in Saturated Animal Fats & Desi Ghee for Dry Winter Skin
description: Combat severe skin dryness in winter by cooking meat in its own saturated fats or Desi Ghee on low heat without adding water. Healthy animal fats reduce bad cholesterol and nourish the skin internally.
body: Combat severe skin dryness in winter by cooking meat in its own saturated fats or Desi Ghee on low heat without adding water. Healthy animal fats reduce bad cholesterol and nourish the skin internally.
urduText: سردیوں کی خشکی کے لیے کھانوں میں دیسی گھی اور چربی کا استعمال کریں، پانی کے بغیر ہلکی آنچ پر پکائیں۔

title: Traditional Clay Pot Water (Ghata Water) vs. Refrigerator Water
description: Avoid ice-cold refrigerator water and commercially treated mineral water. Drinking natural water stored in traditional earthenware clay pots (Ghata) cools the body naturally and balances internal heat.
body: Avoid ice-cold refrigerator water and commercially treated mineral water. Drinking natural water stored in traditional earthenware clay pots (Ghata) cools the body naturally and balances internal heat.
urduText: فریج اور منرل واٹر کے بجائے مٹی کے گھڑے کا قدرتی پانی پئیں۔

title: DIY Heavy-Duty Laundry Powder & Liquid Shampoo Formulas
description: Homemade industrial detergent formula: Combine 10kg Washing Powder (Surf) + 3kg White Washing Soda + 3kg Black Oil + 3kg Salt using a power drill mixer into a uniform cleaning paste/powder. Liquid shampoo is formulated using SLS/SLES base, Vitamin E, and Glycerin.
body: Homemade industrial detergent formula: Combine 10kg Washing Powder (Surf) + 3kg White Washing Soda + 3kg Black Oil + 3kg Salt using a power drill mixer into a uniform cleaning paste/powder. Liquid shampoo is formulated using SLS/SLES base, Vitamin E, and Glycerin.
urduText: سرف ۱۰ کلو + وائٹ سوڈا ۳ کلو + بلیک آئل ۳ کلو + نمک ۳ کلو ملا کر واشنگ پاؤڈر بنائیں۔
